title: Inkk 0.1.2
release_notes:
What's new in Inkk v0.1.2:
- Precision Lasso selection: Enclosure ratio and centroid filtering to accurately select individual strokes without grabbing nearby strokes or background cards
- Clean launch: Set Windows GUI subsystem to permanently eliminate the background command prompt (cmd) window
- Auto-update alert: Automatically displays update modal when a newer version is available
- Splash screen version indicator: Displays current version dynamically
